title: Junta tree failure allocation
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer and let $	au$ be a rational learning parameter with $0<	au\le \tfrac12$. If the per-call failure parameter is obtained by dividing $	au$ by the junta tree call count at depth $k$, then the call count multiplied by that per-call parameter is exactly $	au$.
hypotheses_covered: The failure parameter is rational and satisfies $0<\tau\le\tfrac12$
